cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 26 since November 2022. Financial planner with Ameriprise Financial. Albertville native, University of Alabama graduate, and former legislative intern. Lost the January 2024 special Republican primary for State Senate District 9.
cands.gaps: We found no bills he sponsored and no specific legislative actions that could be matched to the issues in this guide. We found no statements from him on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land ownership, immigration or H-1B visas, policing, or school choice and teacher pay. His campaign site speaks generally about lowering taxes, expanding vocational training and rural broadband, and supporting farmers, but gives no detail. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022, 2024 or 2026. We found no endorsements and no documented controversies. We could not find the name of his family business.
